Package com.nexuslink.protocol.mongo

Class BsonValueParser

java.lang.Object
com.nexuslink.protocol.mongo.BsonValueParser
public final class BsonValueParser extends Object
Turns the text typed into the tree's Value cell back into a BSON value of a chosen type, and builds the $set update that stores it.

This is the difference between a real Mongo tool and a JSON textbox. Saving 1 without saying which numeric type you meant silently rewrites an int64 field as an int32 (or a double), and the next $inc, sort or range query behaves differently. Editing therefore always names the target type, and this class is the only place that maps a type plus a string to a value.

Pure: no driver connection, so every conversion and every rejection is unit-testable.

    • setUpdate

      public static org.bson.Document setUpdate(String path, Object value)
      The update document for setting one field: { $set: { <path>: <value> } }. The path is a BsonNode.path(), so a nested field or an array element updates in place rather than rewriting the whole document — which is what makes concurrent edits safe.

    • unsetUpdate

      public static org.bson.Document unsetUpdate(String path)
      The update document for removing one field: { $unset: { <path>: "" } }.
